falsely.linePrev: And this is not our fate
falsely.line: So let us not talk falsely now
stanza: Who feel that life is but a joke
But you and I, we've been through that
And this is not our fate
So let us not talk falsely now

falsely.lineNext: The crime was murder “one”, guess who testified?
stanza: The crime was murder “one”, guess who testified?
Bello and Bradley and they both baldly lied
And the newspapers, they all went along for the ride
